name: Sealer Application - int_window
intent: Sanding sealer coat by method (brush/spray). Fills grain and builds base for clear topcoat.
doctrine: Sealer apply for int_window. Sealer is always brush or spray — no roll. Dynamic coats from scenario sealer_coats field (typically 1). Rate matches TSK_WIN_CLEAR_* because sealer and clear have equivalent application effort on windows.
